title: Federation Envelope V2 (registry-driven, revisioned, authorization-referenced)
description: Incremental extension of the v1 contract family. producer/consumer are registered project references (not a three-project enum); source/target software and environment are first-class; task revision + baseline kind + immutable artifact digest + receipt location + target capability + authorization reference + supersedes are added. The task body travels only via its immutable snapshot reference (digest on the envelope, content via artifactRef). Authorization is bound to a trusted local grant record, never to model-mutable payload text.

producer.description: registered opaque project reference, not a client id and not a three-value enum

sourceSoftware.description: client/executor identity, kept distinct from the project

environment.description: node/environment binding, e.g. local or a named cloud node

baseline.description: code/workspace baseline — distinct from the task-body revision

bodyDigest.description: digest over the task body; equals the immutable snapshot for Ready publication

authorizationRef.description: trusted local grant record id; the ONLY authorization authority

$comment: v1 readers reject this via the schemaVersion const; v2 readers reject v1 symmetrically — no silent truncation in either direction.
